name: BROUTE
description: We introduce BROUTE, a benchmark suite for vehicle routing optimization algorithms. We define a selection of algorithms traditionally used in vehicle routing optimization. They capture essential features that are also relevant in optimization algorithms for different application domains, like local search move evaluation, memory allocation, dynamic programming, or insertion and deletion from a list. Each algorithm is deterministic. We implement these benchmark algorithms using a selection of programming languages and different data structures. BROUTE is free, open-source, and can be used to inform early decisions in projects that involve programming, such as which language to use.
typical_sota_score: Varies by language and implementation; no single aggregated SOTA metric (performance depends on target hardware, data structures, and algorithm variants)
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark suite for comparing implementation efficiency of vehicle-routing-related algorithms across languages and data structures.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on deterministic algorithm implementations; results depend heavily on language, compiler, and hardware, so scores are not directly comparable across setups.
